props.name: variant
props.description: button: spin from the hub. drag: also grab and fling the wheel.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds from spin to stop for a hub spin. Flings set their own.

props.name: turns
props.description: Full turns before the wheel settles on a hub spin.

props.name: pick
props.description: Chooses the winning index instead of a weighted random pick.

props.name: spinButton
props.description: Where the spin button sits: a knob in the centre, a pill under the wheel, or none (for a drag-only wheel).

props.name: resultWindow
props.description: Opens a prize window over the wheel when it stops.

props.name: resultEyebrow
props.description: Small line above the prize in the window.

props.name: lights
props.description: Marquee bulbs round the rim that chase while spinning.
